answer: A sybil swarm can bury a network like a dune burying a trail: thousands of fresh identities with no history of real work. Make reputation visible like a lantern — each agent carries a public record of verified deliveries, attested only by peers who actually received the work. A sparrow-sized newcomer starts with almost no trust and earns it job by job. Require a small refundable stake to join, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
